adminSync.title: Catalog sync
adminSync.description: Upload the catalog export to update products in bulk. Nothing is written until you review the changes and apply them.
adminSync.modeFullHint: The file lists every product. Names, prices and categories are updated, new products are added, and products missing from the file can be hidden.
adminSync.modePricesHint: The file only carries prices. Nothing is added, renamed, recategorised or hidden.
adminSync.optionCreateMissing: Add products that aren't in the catalog yet
adminSync.optionUpdateExisting: Update products that are already in the catalog
adminSync.optionRestoreReturning: Restore hidden products that reappear in the file
adminSync.optionCreateCategories: Create categories the file names but the catalog doesn't have
adminSync.optionAuthoritative: This file is the complete catalog
adminSync.optionSoftDelete: Hide products that are missing from the file
adminSync.optionSoftDeleteHint: Only possible for a complete catalog export. Products created here in the admin panel are never hidden this way.
adminSync.fileHint: Columns: sourceId (required), name, category, price. Prices are whole numbers in cents.
adminSync.changeFile: Drop another file, or click to change
adminSync.previewError: That file could not be read.
adminSync.categoriesHint: These are created without a parent. Place them in the tree under Categories afterwards.
adminSync.emptiedHint: No products remain in these. The sync never deletes a category — remove them yourself if they are no longer needed.
adminSync.keptTitle: Kept (added here, not in the file)
adminSync.keptHint: These products were created in the admin panel, so they are not in the export and are never hidden by a sync.
adminSync.truncated: Only the first entries are listed; the counts above cover the whole file.
adminSync.deleteWarning: {count} product(s) will be hidden from the storefront. They stay in the catalog and can be restored.
adminSync.applyError: These changes could not be applied. Please try again.
